name: Shelley Kaehr, PhD
reason: No working website of her own: pastlifelady.com, the address in her book and podcast listings, now serves an Indonesian gambling spam page (domain lapsed), and shelleykaehr.com does not resolve (4 Nov 2026); two searches found no other site, so there is no published email or contact form and no own source for base, photo or offerings. Her past-life books (Llewellyn) are real; her work is also framed around 'healing power' of past-life memories, which would need a strict health check if she resurfaces with a site.
